name: What is the process for scheduling a sash repair consultation?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for scheduling a sash repair consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To schedule a sash repair consultation, you can typically contact us via phone or through our website's contact form. We will arrange a convenient time for a technician to visit your property in areas like Pacifica or South San Francisco. During the on-site visit, the technician will assess the condition of your window sashes, identify the issues, discuss potential repair options, and provide a detailed estimate for the work required. This initial consultation helps ensure we understand your needs and provide an accurate quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule a consultation by phone or online. A technician will visit your property to assess damage, discuss options, and provide an estimate.
